verdict.rationale: USCIS's public pages document a 'Case Status Online' tool to track the status of an application, petition, or request. The homepage also links 'Check your case status' among its case-management tools, so a founder can look up their case from the public site. The egov probe only shows the host blocking automated agents at robots.txt; it does not contradict human use. missing for 10: documentation of how the lookup works (inputs such as receipt number, what status detail is shown), independent or hands-on corroboration that the public tool returns status.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: Case Status Online: Track the status of an immigration application, petition, or request.
Use our online tools and resources to manage your case: Check your case status
